page.layout: Full-width running head at top with page number at top right. Below it, two circular portrait medallions side by side, each with a legend around its edge. Below them, one column of text in two paragraphs. A gathering signature and a woodcut ornament sit at the foot.

main_text.p: MARIANVS Socinus Senensis Iunior celeberrimus iuris professor, quanto ingenio quantáque doctrina emicuerit, testantur tot eius non minus elegátia quàm grauia scripta. Docuit Pisis, Senis, deinde Patauij annos quā plurimos: postremò Bononiam euocatus, ibi summa cùm laude semper est profes-sus, in magna auditorum frequentia. Claruit anno Christi 1566. Scripsit tria magna consiliorum volumina. Commentaria quæ in celebrioribus Italiæ gymnasiis vulgò leguntur, & alia plurima, quorum elenchum potes videre in Bibliotheca Gesneri.

HIERONYMVS Cagnolus patritius Vercellésis eques & Iurisconsultus clarissimus, illustrissimi Ducis Sabaudiæ Senator, ac professor Iuris Cæsarei Patauij: de re literaria optimè meruit, utpote qui ad promouenda studia legum, multa memoriæ tradiderit scriptisque mandauerit, unde non mediocrem honorem est adeptus. Scripsit de Origine Iuris. Item copiosam & subtilem interpretationè omnium legum tituli ff. de reg. iuris. Floruit circiter annum salutis 1540. Omnia eius opera in tres tomos distributa impressa sunt Lugduni 1569. in folio.

page.notes: The medallion legends are printed around the portraits; the second legend is partly obscured and "CAGNOL." is read with doubt. The ornament at the foot has no text. The "&" before "subtilem" is printed close to a following letter and may be "&c" in the print. The first word of the second paragraph is in larger capitals, so it stays in the paragraph and is not a heading.
